Subject: Redwood onboarding / console + API quickstart — kickoff request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the trial access — the team is excited to get a hands-on run of the console and a quick API walkthrough so our infra and product folks are comfortable with the integration path.

Can we schedule a 90-minute session next week focused on:
- Console walkthrough (routes, model selection, token/usage reporting) — 40m
- API quickstart + sample integration (SDK snippet, auth, rate limits) — 35m
- Q&A and next steps / MAP review — 15m

Our preferred window is Tue/Wed afternoon PST; if that's tight, we can take a morning slot. Not urgent but would like to lock something before our procurement runs next month.
